scope: Corollary 8.2 (Virtual structure in the torsion-free case) of the manuscript “A Modulus Proof of Cannon’s Conjecture” (preprints/A-Modulus-Proof-of-Cannons-Conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 246 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 650697e8e95aa8cb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 29. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let G be a torsion-free hyperbolic group with ∂G homeomorphic to S2. Some finite-index subgroup of G is isomorphic to π1(Σ) ⋊ Z for a closed connected orientable surface Σ. In particular, G has positive virtual first Betti number. Moreover, G is virtually compact special and residually finite.
